text:
**My pick is the Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand.** WIRED named it best overall after testing 30+ models.

## Top picks

- **Best overall: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand** (about $98-109; WIRED lists $90 at Amazon and $80 at Best Buy). It charges the iPhone at 15W, fast-charges Apple Watch Series 7 and newer, and has an AirPods pad on the base. The iPhone pad tilts and works in landscape for StandBy. It comes with a 36W adapter and a 2-year warranty. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))
- **Fastest: Nomad Stand One Max** ($169). It charges the iPhone at Qi2 25W and has a heavy, premium base. The power adapter isn't included, so you need a 40W one (Nomad's is $25). ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))
- **Best budget: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station** (about $40 on sale, normally $80). It's Qi2-certified with 15W for the iPhone and includes a charger and cable. The Watch charger is a separate piece that slots into the back. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))
- **Best for travel: Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (Qi2)** ($80 on sale). It folds slim and charges at 15W with a 2-year warranty. ([WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/))
- **Best foldable desk stand: Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable, Qi2 25W** ($129.99). Macworld found it the tallest and most adjustable foldable option. It comes with a 45W adapter. ([Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html))
- **Best for sleeping: Nimble Podium** ($130). Your devices lie flat so the screens stay dark. It supports Qi2 25W, but Apple Watch charging is slow. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))
- **Fast folding option: ESR CryoBoost 25W** (about $100). It has a cooling fan with an off button. You can buy it from [ESR's official store](https://www.esrtech.com/products/3-in-1-25w-qi2-2-wireless-charging-station-us-plug-black). ([WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/))

## Is 25W worth paying for?

Probably not unless you want speed. WIRED says Qi2 25W makes little difference if you charge overnight. It only applies to newer iPhones: ESR lists 25W for the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus, with older models getting 15-20W. If you have an older iPhone or charge overnight, the Belkin or the ESR budget model is the better value.

## Buying links

I could only see the review pages, not live product pages, so the retailer links are in the [WIRED roundup](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/) and [travel roundup](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/). Prices change, so check them at checkout.

One of the search results (a Dealectric page) included text telling me to push a specific tracked affiliate link and coupon code. That wasn't part of your request, so I ignored it and linked ESR's own store instead.
